name: fetch
description: Fetch a web page and return its main content as markdown.

upstream.description: Benchmark parameter: base URL of the page server.

latency_ms.description: Benchmark parameter: server response delay in milliseconds.

size.description: Benchmark parameter: page size in bytes.

seed.description: Benchmark parameter: selects the generated page.

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return.

start_index.description: Return content starting at this character, for paging through long pages.

reuse_connection.description: Benchmark parameter: keep the connection alive across calls.
